narration: Here's the bank trick nobody talks about. Your savings account pays you 0.03% — that's twelve dollars a year. Your bank turns around and lends your money out at seven percent.
visual: Dark background. SVG bank building springs in from center. Two stat columns appear: YOU (0.03%, $12/yr in white) vs BANK (7%+, $3,400/yr in red). Bold uppercase text 'THE BANK SECRET' at top.

narration: The average American keeps $41,600 in checking and savings combined. At the big-bank rate of 0.03%, that earns you exactly twelve dollars and forty-eight cents a year. Wild, right?
visual: Light background. Person silhouette next to a pink piggy bank SVG. Animated counter counts up to $41,600. Then a red box appears showing '$12.48 PER YEAR' highlighted in shock contrast.

narration: Your bank bundles all those deposits and lends them out as mortgages, car loans, and credit cards. The gap between what they earn and what they pay you has a name — it's called the net interest margin.
visual: Dark background. Two money bag SVGs side by side: a small gray bag labeled 'YOUR SHARE $12/yr' and a large red bag labeled 'BANK'S SHARE $1,373/yr'. Size contrast is dramatic.

narration: Big banks averaged a 3.3% net interest margin last year. On your $41,600, that's over thirteen hundred dollars in pure bank profit — from your own money — every single year.
visual: Light background. Animated bar chart grows: a tiny gray bar for YOU ($12) next to a tall red bar for BANK ($1,373). Numbers animate up as bars grow. Callout: '3.3% NET INTEREST MARGIN' at bottom.

narration: High-yield savings accounts are paying 4.5% right now — same FDIC protection, same access to your cash. On $41,600 that's $1,872 a year. Over ten years, the compounding difference is twenty-two thousand dollars.
visual: Dark background. Two vertical bars animate up: a short gray bar for 'BIG BANK 0.03%' and a tall green bar for 'HYSA 4.5%'. Earnings animate as bars grow. '$22,000' appears large in green.

narration: Your bank isn't your friend — it's a business profiting from your inertia. Open a high-yield savings account today and take that money back. It takes about five minutes.
